carrier_frequency_mhz.name: Carrier Frequency
carrier_frequency_mhz.description: NFC carrier frequency per ISO 14443-2. Deviation from 13.56 MHz affects reader-to-tag communication reliability and power transfer efficiency. This is a synthetic illustrative limit.

load_modulation_mv.name: Load Modulation Amplitude
load_modulation_mv.description: Peak load modulation amplitude at the reader antenna terminals. Insufficient modulation depth reduces data integrity at distance. This is a synthetic illustrative limit.

receiver_sensitivity_dbm.name: Receiver Sensitivity
receiver_sensitivity_dbm.description: Minimum detectable signal power at the RF input. Lower values indicate better sensitivity. Values above USL indicate degraded sensitivity; values below LSL may indicate measurement or calibration anomalies. This is a synthetic illustrative limit.

modulation_depth_pct.name: Modulation Depth
modulation_depth_pct.description: ASK (Amplitude Shift Keying) modulation depth as defined in ISO 14443-2. Values outside this range may cause decoding errors in NFC reader ICs. This is a synthetic illustrative limit.
